scope: Isolated database hmdp_optimization_test; the full regression command passed in a single run. This is not the same as a visitor running every test from the page.

features.feature: Request-scope cache, LoadingCache, Memcache, versioned namespaces and backfill
features.boundary: Independent CacheClient instances and concurrent threads within one JVM; no multi-node Java deployment for failure drills

features.feature: Null-value caching, mutex rebuild, stale-backfill isolation, TTL, Memcache failure fallback
features.boundary: Not tested against Redis Cluster, primary/replica failover or sustained cache-avalanche load

features.feature: Canal: external SQL changes, deletes, voucher moved to another shop, reconnect, ACK after success
features.boundary: Real single-instance Canal/MySQL; long binlog expiry and cluster failover not tested

features.feature: Lua flash-sale purchase, concurrent race for the last unit, duplicate orders, transactions and the purchase-slot unique constraint
features.boundary: Tests call the service layer directly; not an HTTP flash-sale capacity load test

features.feature: Stream pending-entry takeover, poison-message isolation, state, compensation, recovery and reconciliation
features.boundary: The related admin HTTP success paths are not yet systematically covered; the app currently has no admin allowlist

features.feature: Outbox, idempotent inbox, lost send acknowledgements, consume-before-ack, lease recovery
features.boundary: Controlled faults and a real single broker; host power loss and multi-replica failover not tested

features.feature: RocketMQ flash-sale fulfilment, redelivery, delayed order closing and payment races
features.boundary: 3 tests against a real broker; payment is simulated locally, and mock payment is disabled in the business environment

features.feature: Kafka page-view tracking, transactional outbox, PV/UV windows and de-duplication
features.boundary: 2 tests against a real broker; page-view tracking tolerates loss, and no cross-store exactly-once is claimed

features.feature: Duplicate protection for deals, cancel-and-reorder, order snapshots, timeout closing
features.boundary: The full HTTP sign-in → order → lookup loop is not yet systematically covered; no real payment, refund or redemption

features.feature: Idempotent likes and follows, feed fan-out, image ownership, delete-vs-publish races and retries
features.boundary: Partly tested at controller/service level; not every HTTP binding, pagination case or invalid input is covered

features.feature: Sign-in code rate limiting and single use, authorization, monitoring credentials, admin isolation
features.boundary: Real SMS delivery is out of scope; check-ins and check-in streaks lack dedicated automated assertions

features.feature: Search: database pagination, boundaries and mapper layering
features.boundary: catalog/batch/areas public reads currently succeed; HTTP scenarios for create and update still need coverage
Single instance, hot key, concurrency 8, 10,000 requests per phase; cannot be used to claim flash-sale or production capacity
Targets up and rules health=ok; not every alert was triggered and external notifications were not verified

limitations: BlogCommentsController is empty; there is no comment endpoint
Token bundles, quota ledger and entitlement-account migration
Redis Cluster same-slot refactoring and high-availability drills
